# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: UNI 1970 scripted effects — scripted effects.
## COLDWAR | Cold War mod (MD Imperia) - The Union Plan 1970 (Soviet Union and the 14 Union republics)
## Generated by the COLDWAR Soviet generator (Claude outputs/COLDWAR_SOV_generator/cw_union.py).
## Concept: project doc claude/mdcw_union_missions_concept.md. Edit the generator, not this file.

# THIS = republic: temp COLDWAR_UNI_w = what its failure weighs (UKR 3; BLR, KAZ, UZB 2; others 1)
COLDWAR_UNI_weight_of = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_w = 1 }
	if = { limit = { OR = { original_tag = BLR original_tag = KAZ original_tag = UZB } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_w = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { original_tag = UKR } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_w = 3 } }
}

# SOV scope, from the January session of the Politburo (COLDWAR_SOV.10), after a new Five-Year Plan has been started
COLDWAR_UNI_january_session = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_year_running } COLDWAR_UNI_settle_year = yes }
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_system
	# the Tolkachi may move a deadline only while the new date stays inside the plan year
	set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UNI_rearm_45 days = 317 }
	set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UNI_rearm_30 days = 332 }
	set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UNI_rearm_15 days = 347 }
	country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.1 days = 14 }
}

}

	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_directive_active
}

# THIS = republic: Moscow's priority mission (x1.5) is issued at once; with The Union Plan the republic may choose another (event 3)
COLDWAR_UNI_issue_annual_target = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_target_active
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_target_fulfilled
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_target_failed
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_t_reported
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_t_stormed
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_t_ai_done
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_t_delivered
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_t_tolkachi
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_t_rearmed
	if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_civ } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_civ }
	if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_arms } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_arms }
	if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_power } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_power }
	if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_agri } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_agri }
	if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_roads } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_roads }
	if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_dock } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_dock }
	if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_oil } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_oil }
	if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_deliver } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_deliver }
	if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_discipline } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_discipline }
	if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_steel } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_steel }
	if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_cotton } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_cotton }
	if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_virgin } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_virgin }
	if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_orchards } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_orchards }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_t_days = 300 } }
	set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = COLDWAR_UNI_r min = 0 max = 21 }
	round_temp_variable = COLDWAR_UNI_r
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_t_days = COLDWAR_UNI_r } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_t_key = global.COLDWAR_UNI_prio } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_prio = 5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { original_tag = UZB }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_t_key = 13 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = TRK }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_t_key = 13 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = TAJ }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_t_key = 13 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = KYR }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_t_key = 13 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = KAZ }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_t_key = 14 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = MLV }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_t_key = 15 } }
		}
		else = {
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_t_key = 5 } }
		}
	}
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_prio_key = COLDWAR_UNI_t_key } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_t_tier = 2 } }
	COLDWAR_UNI_start_target = yes
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_target_active
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = yes }
		COLDWAR_UNI_ai_floor = yes
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_tree_started } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.3 } }
	else = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.4 } }
}

# THIS = republic, new COLDWAR_UNI_t_key / _t_tier set: replaces the issued annual target (the deadline stays the same length)
COLDWAR_UNI_switch_target = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_target_active }
		if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_civ } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_civ }
		if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_arms } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_arms }
		if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_power } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_power }
		if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_agri } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_agri }
		if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_roads } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_roads }
		if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_dock } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_dock }
		if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_oil } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_oil }
		if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_deliver } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_deliver }
		if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_discipline } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_discipline }
		if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_steel } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_steel }
		if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_cotton } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_cotton }
		if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_virgin } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_virgin }
		if = { limit = { has_active_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_orchards } remove_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_orchards }
		COLDWAR_UNI_start_target = yes
	}
}

# THIS = AI republic: three in four AI republics fulfil their annual target (otherwise AI-heavy games could never reach 9 of 14)
COLDWAR_UNI_ai_floor = {
	random_list = {
		75 = {
			random_list = {
				25 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.90 days = 120 } }
				25 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.90 days = 180 } }
				25 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.90 days = 240 } }
				25 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.90 days = 280 } }
			}
		}
		25 = { }
	}
}

COLDWAR_UNI_ai_floor_directive = {
	random_list = {
		60 = {
			random_list = {
				50 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.91 days = 120 } }
				50 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.91 days = 200 } }
			}
		}
		40 = { }
	}
}

# THIS = republic: the annual target is fulfilled (also by a false report, by storming, or by the AI floor)
COLDWAR_UNI_target_done = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_target_active
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_t_reported } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_reported_false }
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_target_fulfilled
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_fulfilled = 1 } }
	# Socialist Emulation counts the fulfilled annual targets of the running Five-Year Plan
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_fp_plan = global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan } } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_fp_plan = global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_fulfilled_plan = 0 } } }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_fulfilled_plan = 1 } }
	COLDWAR_UNI_add_deliveries = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_year_won } COLDWAR_UNI_add_union_buff = yes }
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_UNI_target_counts_tt
}

COLDWAR_UNI_directive_done = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_directive_active
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_d_reported } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_reported_false }
	COLDWAR_UNI_add_deliveries = yes
}

COLDWAR_UNI_add_deliveries = {
	COLDWAR_UNI_weight_of = yes
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_dl_pts = COLDWAR_UNI_w } }
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_UNI_deliveries_tt
	hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.43 days = 180 } }
	COLDWAR_UNI_update_deliveries = yes
}

# THIS = republic: the annual target has failed
COLDWAR_UNI_target_failed = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_target_active
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_target_failed
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_fail_directive
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_fail_exposed
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_fail_target
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_mult = 1 }
	COLDWAR_UNI_add_shortfall = yes
	news_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.30 hours = 6 }
	SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.10 days = 1 } }
}

COLDWAR_UNI_directive_failed = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_directive_active
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_fail_target
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_fail_exposed
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_fail_directive
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_mult = 1 }
	COLDWAR_UNI_add_shortfall = yes
	news_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.30 hours = 6 }
	SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.10 days = 1 } }
}

# THIS = republic, temp COLDWAR_UNI_mult (1, or 2 for an exposed false report): each failure weighs on Moscow for 180 days, stacking
COLDWAR_UNI_add_shortfall = {
	COLDWAR_UNI_weight_of = yes
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_p = COLDWAR_UNI_w }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_p = COLDWAR_UNI_mult }
	hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sf_pts = COLDWAR_UNI_p } }
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_UNI_shortfall_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_mult = 2 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.42 days = 180 } }
		else = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.41 days = 180 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_UNI_update_shortfall = yes
}

# THIS = republic (events 41 and 42)
COLDWAR_UNI_expire_shortfall = {
	# temp COLDWAR_UNI_w = the points whose 180 days are over; points that khozraschet already took out (sf_void) are used up first
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sf_void > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sf_void < COLDWAR_UNI_w } } }
			hidden_effect = { subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sf_void = COLDWAR_UNI_w } }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_w = 0 }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_w = COLDWAR_UNI_sf_void }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sf_void = 0 } }
		}
	}
	hidden_effect = { subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sf_pts = COLDWAR_UNI_w } }
	hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UNI_sf_pts min = 0 } }
	COLDWAR_UNI_update_shortfall = yes
}

# any scope: Moscow's shortfall = the sum of the failure points of every republic
COLDWAR_UNI_update_shortfall = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sum = 0 }
	every_country = { limit = { has_variable = COLDWAR_UNI_sf_pts } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sum = COLDWAR_UNI_sf_pts } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_sf_total = COLDWAR_UNI_sum } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_sf_pct = COLDWAR_UNI_sum } }
	hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_sf_pct = 2.5 } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_cg_pct = COLDWAR_UNI_sum } }
	hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_cg_pct = 1 } }
	SOV = {
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sf_build = COLDWAR_UNI_sum } }
		hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sf_build = -0.025 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sf_pp = COLDWAR_UNI_sum } }
		hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sf_pp = -0.025 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sf_cg = COLDWAR_UNI_sum } }
		hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sf_cg = 0.01 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sum > 0 } NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_UNI_shortfall } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_UNI_shortfall } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sum < 0.5 } has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_UNI_shortfall } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_UNI_shortfall } }
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_UNI_update_deliveries = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sum = 0 }
	every_country = { limit = { has_variable = COLDWAR_UNI_dl_pts } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sum = COLDWAR_UNI_dl_pts } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_dl_total = COLDWAR_UNI_sum } }
	SOV = {
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_dl_build = COLDWAR_UNI_sum } }
		hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_dl_build = 0.01 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_dl_pp = COLDWAR_UNI_sum } }
		hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_dl_pp = 0.01 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sum > 0 } NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_UNI_deliveries } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_UNI_deliveries } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_sum < 0.5 } has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_UNI_deliveries } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_UNI_deliveries } }
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
}

# any member: The Plan Is Fulfilled! (the variant of the plan whose directives the Union has adopted)
COLDWAR_UNI_add_union_buff = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_plan_fulfilled } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_plan_fulfilled }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_plan_fulfilled_9 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_plan_fulfilled_9 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_plan_fulfilled_10 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_plan_fulfilled_10 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_plan_fulfilled_11 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_plan_fulfilled_11 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_plan_fulfilled_12 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_plan_fulfilled_12 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_year_plan = 9 } has_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_directives_9 }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_UNI_plan_fulfilled_9 days = 365 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_year_plan = 10 } has_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_directives_10 }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_UNI_plan_fulfilled_10 days = 365 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_year_plan = 11 } has_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_directives_11 }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_UNI_plan_fulfilled_11 days = 365 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_year_plan = 12 } has_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_directives_12 }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_UNI_plan_fulfilled_12 days = 365 }
	}
	else = {
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_UNI_plan_fulfilled days = 365 }
	}
}

# SOV scope: enough republics have fulfilled their annual target
COLDWAR_UNI_union_plan_won = {
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_year_won
	COLDWAR_UNI_add_union_buff = yes
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta = 2 }
	COLDWAR_SOV_change_union_cohesion = yes
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_UNI_buff_fulfillers_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_target_fulfilled COLDWAR_UNI_is_republic = yes } COLDWAR_UNI_add_union_buff = yes }
	}
	news_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.32 hours = 6 }
}

# SOV scope: the plan year closes
COLDWAR_UNI_settle_year = {
	# People's Control (Union tree) or Andropov's discipline campaign: the false reports of the year are audited
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_peoples_control has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_discipline_campaign } }
		every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_reported_false COLDWAR_UNI_is_republic = yes } COLDWAR_UNI_audit = yes }
	}
	every_country = { limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_last_ok has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_last_fail } } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_last_ok clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_last_fail }
	every_country = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_UNI_is_republic = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_target_fulfilled } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_last_ok }
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_last_fail }
	}
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_last_year = global.COLDWAR_UNI_year } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_last_fulfilled = global.COLDWAR_UNI_fulfilled } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_last_needed = global.COLDWAR_UNI_needed } }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_last_members = global.COLDWAR_UNI_members } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_year_won }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_last_won
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_year_plan = 9 } }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_good_years_9 = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_year_plan = 10 } }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_good_years_10 = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_year_plan = 11 } }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_good_years_11 = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_year_plan = 12 } }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_good_years_12 = 1 } }
		}
	}
	else = { clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_last_won }
	# fewer than 5 of 14: Plan Shortfall for Moscow (the existing idea)
	clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_last_shortfall
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_share = global.COLDWAR_UNI_fulfilled }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_members > 0 } } divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_share = global.COLDWAR_UNI_members } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_share < 0.357 } check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_members > 0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_plan_shortfall } hidden_effect = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_plan_shortfall } } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_SOV_plan_shortfall days = 365 }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_last_shortfall
	}
	# Socialist Emulation: the four Transferable Red Banners pass every quarter (cw_emulation.py, COLDWAR_SOV_pb_award_banners)
	# the false reports of the closed year have had their audit: they lapse (kompromat still uses COLDWAR_SOV_pripiski)
	every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_reported_false } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_reported_false }
	clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_year_running
	news_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.34 hours = 12 }
}

# THIS = republic with a false report this year (the chance of COLDWAR_SOV_investigate_republic)
COLDWAR_UNI_audit = {
	COLDWAR_SOV_investigation_chance = yes
	set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = COLDWAR_UNI_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_roll < COLDWAR_SOV_chance } } COLDWAR_UNI_pripiski_exposed = yes }
}

# THIS = republic: its false plan report (pripiski) is uncovered (by an SOV decision, focus or event, or by the January audit)
COLDWAR_UNI_pripiski_exposed = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_reported_false
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UNI_exposed days = 730 }
	# the false fulfilment no longer counts
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_t_reported has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_target_fulfilled }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_target_fulfilled
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_target_failed
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_UNI_fulfilled = -1 } }
		hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = global.COLDWAR_UNI_fulfilled min = 0 } }
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_industry_1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_industry_1 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_industry_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_industry_2 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_industry_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_industry_3 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_power_1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_power_1 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_power_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_power_2 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_power_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_power_3 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_agri_1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_agri_1 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_agri_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_agri_2 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_agri_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_agri_3 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_infra_1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_infra_1 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_infra_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_infra_2 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_infra_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_infra_3 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_deliver_1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_deliver_1 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_deliver_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_deliver_2 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_deliver_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_deliver_3 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_discipline_1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_discipline_1 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_discipline_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_discipline_2 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_discipline_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_discipline_3 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_komsomol_1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_komsomol_1 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_komsomol_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_komsomol_2 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_komsomol_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_komsomol_3 }
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_lost_tt
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_in_disgrace } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_in_disgrace hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_disgrace_left = 2 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat } COLDWAR_SOV_leave_seat = yes }
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pripiski
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_fail_target
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_fail_directive
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_fail_exposed
	# the false figures are struck from the Socialist Emulation too (cw_emulation.py)
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_pb_disqualified } } COLDWAR_SOV_pb_disqualify = yes }
	# a lie and a failure: the points count twice
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_mult = 2 }
	COLDWAR_UNI_add_shortfall = yes
	hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.45 } }
}

COLDWAR_UNI_judgement_cost = {
	# temp COLDWAR_UNI_lvl (1 reprimand, 2 economic, 3 replacement) and COLDWAR_UNI_base (the cohesion the level costs)
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_lvl = 2 } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_iron_discipline } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_base = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_lvl < 3 } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_party_control FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat } } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_base = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_lvl > 1 } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_local_barons has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_bre } multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_base = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { FROM = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_base = 1 } }
	if = {
		limit = { FROM = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_cadre_protection has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_patron_in_moscow } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_base = 2 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_defying_the_politburo } hidden_effect = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_defying_the_politburo } } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_SOV_defying_the_politburo days = 180 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_base > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta = COLDWAR_UNI_base }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta = -1 }
		COLDWAR_SOV_change_union_cohesion = yes
	}
}

# THIS = republic: a quarter of its civilian factories (1-3) work for Moscow for 60 days
COLDWAR_UNI_apply_requisition = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_req = industrial_complex_total }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_req = 0.25 }
	round_temp_variable = COLDWAR_UNI_req
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UNI_req min = 1 max = 3 }
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_req_n = COLDWAR_UNI_req } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_req = 3 } } if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_requisition_3 } hidden_effect = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_requisition_3 } } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_UNI_requisition_3 days = 60 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_req = 2 } } if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_requisition_2 } hidden_effect = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_requisition_2 } } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_UNI_requisition_2 days = 60 } }
	else = { if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_requisition_1 } hidden_effect = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_requisition_1 } } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_UNI_requisition_1 days = 60 } }
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UNI_requisitioned days = 60 }
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_UNI_requisition_sov_tt
	SOV = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_req_sum = COLDWAR_UNI_req } } COLDWAR_UNI_update_requisition = yes }
	hidden_effect = {
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.44 days = 60 }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.13 days = 1 }
	}
}

# SOV scope: freed civilian factories = the sum of all running requisitions
COLDWAR_UNI_update_requisition = {
	hidden_effect = {
		hidden_effect = { clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UNI_req_sum min = 0 } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_req_cfu = COLDWAR_UNI_req_sum } }
		hidden_effect = { multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_req_cfu = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_req_sum > 0 } NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_UNI_requisition_gain } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_UNI_requisition_gain } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_req_sum < 0.5 } has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_UNI_requisition_gain } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_UNI_requisition_gain } }
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
}

# THIS = republic: Moscow replaces the First Secretary (successors from history, then a third name)
COLDWAR_UNI_replace_first_secretary = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_UNI_replace_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_replaced = 1 } }
		retire_country_leader = yes
		if = {
			limit = { original_tag = UKR }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_replaced < 1.5 } }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Volodymyr Shcherbytsky" picture = "gfx/leaders/UKR/shcherbytsky.dds" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state COLDWAR_UNI_moscows_man } }
			}

				limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_replaced < 2.5 } }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Volodymyr Ivashko" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state COLDWAR_UNI_moscows_man } }
			}
			else = {
				create_country_leader = { name = "Stanislav Hurenko" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state COLDWAR_UNI_moscows_man } }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = BLR }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_replaced < 1.5 } }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Tikhon Kiselyov" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state COLDWAR_UNI_moscows_man } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_replaced < 2.5 } }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Nikolai Slyunkov" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state COLDWAR_UNI_moscows_man } }
			}
			else = {
				create_country_leader = { name = "Yefrem Sokolov" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state COLDWAR_UNI_moscows_man } }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = EST }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_replaced < 1.5 } }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Karl Vaino" picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/EST_karl_vaino.dds" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state COLDWAR_UNI_moscows_man } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_replaced < 2.5 } }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Vaino Valjas" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state COLDWAR_UNI_moscows_man } }
			}
			else = {
				create_country_leader = { name = "Enn-Arno Sillari" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state COLDWAR_UNI_moscows_man } }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = LAT }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_replaced < 1.5 } }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Boris Pugo" picture = "gfx/leaders/LAT/pugo.dds" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state COLDWAR_UNI_moscows_man } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_replaced < 2.5 } }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Janis Vagris" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state COLDWAR_UNI_moscows_man } }
			}
			else = {
				create_country_leader = { name = "Alfreds Rubiks" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state COLDWAR_UNI_moscows_man } }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = LIT }
